blocks.source: Canto XX
blocks.translation: Canto XX

blocks.source: Di nova pena mi conven far versi
blocks.translation: Of a new pain behoves me to make verses

blocks.source: e dar matera al ventesimo canto
blocks.translation: And give material to the twentieth canto

blocks.source: de la prima canzon, ch’è d’i sommersi.
blocks.translation: Of the first song, which is of the submerged.

blocks.source: Io era già disposto tutto quanto
blocks.translation: I was already thoroughly disposed

blocks.source: a riguardar ne lo scoperto fondo,
blocks.translation: To peer down into the uncovered depth,

blocks.source: che si bagnava d’angoscioso pianto;
blocks.translation: Which bathed itself with tears of agony;

blocks.source: e vidi gente per lo vallon tondo
blocks.translation: And people saw I through the circular valley,

blocks.source: venir, tacendo e lagrimando, al passo
blocks.translation: Silent and weeping, coming at the pace

blocks.source: che fanno le letane in questo mondo.
blocks.translation: Which in this world the Litanies assume.

blocks.source: Come ’l viso mi scese in lor più basso,
blocks.translation: As lower down my sight descended on them,

blocks.source: mirabilmente apparve esser travolto
blocks.translation: Wondrously each one seemed to be distorted

blocks.source: ciascun tra ’l mento e ’l principio del casso,
blocks.translation: From chin to the beginning of the chest;

blocks.source: ché da le reni era tornato ’l volto,
blocks.translation: For tow’rds the reins the countenance was turned,

blocks.source: e in dietro venir li convenia,
blocks.translation: And backward it behoved them to advance,

blocks.source: perché ’l veder dinanzi era lor tolto.
blocks.translation: As to look forward had been taken from them.

blocks.source: Forse per forza già di parlasia
blocks.translation: Perchance indeed by violence of palsy

blocks.source: si travolse così alcun del tutto;
blocks.translation: Some one has been thus wholly turned awry;

blocks.source: ma io nol vidi, né credo che sia.
blocks.translation: But I ne’er saw it, nor believe it can be.

blocks.source: Se Dio ti lasci, lettor, prender frutto
blocks.translation: As God may let thee, Reader, gather fruit

blocks.source: di tua lezione, or pensa per te stesso
blocks.translation: From this thy reading, think now for thyself

blocks.source: com’ io potea tener lo viso asciutto,
blocks.translation: How I could ever keep my face unmoistened,

blocks.source: quando la nostra imagine di presso
blocks.translation: When our own image near me I beheld

blocks.source: vidi sì torta, che ’l pianto de li occhi
blocks.translation: Distorted so, the weeping of the eyes

blocks.source: le natiche bagnava per lo fesso.
blocks.translation: Along the fissure bathed the hinder parts.

blocks.source: Certo io piangea, poggiato a un de’ rocchi
blocks.translation: Truly I wept, leaning upon a peak

blocks.source: del duro scoglio, sì che la mia scorta
blocks.translation: Of the hard crag, so that my Escort said

blocks.source: mi disse: «Ancor se’ tu de li altri sciocchi?
blocks.translation: To me: “Art thou, too, of the other fools?

blocks.source: Qui vive la pietà quand’ è ben morta;
blocks.translation: Here pity lives when it is wholly dead;

blocks.source: chi è più scellerato che colui
blocks.translation: Who is a greater reprobate than he

blocks.source: che al giudicio divin passion comporta?
blocks.translation: Who feels compassion at the doom divine?

blocks.source: Drizza la testa, drizza, e vedi a cui
blocks.translation: Lift up, lift up thy head, and see for whom

blocks.source: s’aperse a li occhi d’i Teban la terra;
blocks.translation: Opened the earth before the Thebans’ eyes;

blocks.source: per ch’ei gridavan tutti: “Dove rui,
blocks.translation: Wherefore they all cried: ‘Whither rushest thou,

blocks.source: Anfïarao? perché lasci la guerra?”.
blocks.translation: Amphiaraus?  Why dost leave the war?’

blocks.source: E non restò di ruinare a valle
blocks.translation: And downward ceased he not to fall amain

blocks.source: fino a Minòs che ciascheduno afferra.
blocks.translation: As far as Minos, who lays hold on all.

blocks.source: Mira c’ha fatto petto de le spalle;
blocks.translation: See, he has made a bosom of his shoulders!

blocks.source: perché volle veder troppo davante,
blocks.translation: Because he wished to see too far before him

blocks.source: di retro guarda e fa retroso calle.
blocks.translation: Behind he looks, and backward goes his way:

blocks.source: Vedi Tiresia, che mutò sembiante
blocks.translation: Behold Tiresias, who his semblance changed,

blocks.source: quando di maschio femmina divenne,
blocks.translation: When from a male a female he became,

blocks.source: cangiandosi le membra tutte quante;
blocks.translation: His members being all of them transformed;

blocks.source: e prima, poi, ribatter li convenne
blocks.translation: And afterwards was forced to strike once more

blocks.source: li duo serpenti avvolti, con la verga,
blocks.translation: The two entangled serpents with his rod,

blocks.source: che rïavesse le maschili penne.
blocks.translation: Ere he could have again his manly plumes.

blocks.source: Aronta è quel ch’al ventre li s’atterga,
blocks.translation: That Aruns is, who backs the other’s belly,

blocks.source: che ne’ monti di Luni, dove ronca
blocks.translation: Who in the hills of Luni, there where grubs

blocks.source: lo Carrarese che di sotto alberga,
blocks.translation: The Carrarese who houses underneath,

blocks.source: ebbe tra ’ bianchi marmi la spelonca
blocks.translation: Among the marbles white a cavern had

blocks.source: per sua dimora; onde a guardar le stelle
blocks.translation: For his abode; whence to behold the stars

blocks.source: e ’l mar non li era la veduta tronca.
blocks.translation: And sea, the view was not cut off from him.

blocks.source: E quella che ricuopre le mammelle,
blocks.translation: And she there, who is covering up her breasts,

blocks.source: che tu non vedi, con le trecce sciolte,
blocks.translation: Which thou beholdest not, with loosened tresses,

blocks.source: e ha di là ogne pilosa pelle,
blocks.translation: And on that side has all the hairy skin,

blocks.source: Manto fu, che cercò per terre molte;
blocks.translation: Was Manto, who made quest through many lands,

blocks.source: poscia si puose là dove nacqu’ io;
blocks.translation: Afterwards tarried there where I was born;

blocks.source: onde un poco mi piace che m’ascolte.
blocks.translation: Whereof I would thou list to me a little.

blocks.source: Poscia che ’l padre suo di vita uscìo
blocks.translation: After her father had from life departed,

blocks.source: e venne serva la città di Baco,
blocks.translation: And the city of Bacchus had become enslaved,

blocks.source: questa gran tempo per lo mondo gio.
blocks.translation: She a long season wandered through the world.

blocks.source: Suso in Italia bella giace un laco,
blocks.translation: Above in beauteous Italy lies a lake

blocks.source: a piè de l’Alpe che serra Lamagna
blocks.translation: At the Alp’s foot that shuts in Germany

blocks.source: sovra Tiralli, c’ha nome Benaco.
blocks.translation: Over Tyrol, and has the name Benaco.

blocks.source: Per mille fonti, credo, e più si bagna
blocks.translation: By a thousand springs, I think, and more, is watered

blocks.source: tra Garda e Val Camonica e Pennino
blocks.translation: The land between Garda, Val Camonica, and Pennino,

blocks.source: de l’acqua che nel detto laco stagna.
blocks.translation: With waters gathered in the aforesaid lake.

blocks.source: Loco è nel mezzo là dove ’l trentino
blocks.translation: Midway a place is where the Trentine Pastor,

blocks.source: pastore e quel di Brescia e ’l veronese
blocks.translation: And he of Brescia, and the Veronese

blocks.source: segnar poria, s’e’ fesse quel cammino.
blocks.translation: Might give his blessing, if he passed that way.

blocks.source: Siede Peschiera, bello e forte arnese
blocks.translation: Sitteth Peschiera, fortress fair and strong,

blocks.source: da fronteggiar Bresciani e Bergamaschi,
blocks.translation: To front the Brescians and the Bergamasks,

blocks.source: ove la riva ’ntorno più discese.
blocks.translation: Where round about the bank descendeth lowest.

blocks.source: Ivi convien che tutto quanto caschi
blocks.translation: There of necessity must fall whatever

blocks.source: ciò che ’n grembo a Benaco star non può,
blocks.translation: In bosom of Benaco cannot stay,

blocks.source: e fassi fiume giù per verdi paschi.
blocks.translation: And grows a river down through verdant pastures.

blocks.source: Tosto che l’acqua a correr mette co,
blocks.translation: Soon as the water doth begin to run,

blocks.source: non più Benaco, ma Mencio si chiama
blocks.translation: No more Benaco is it called, but Mincio,

blocks.source: fino a Governol, dove cade in Po.
blocks.translation: Far as Governo, where it falls in Po.

blocks.source: Non molto ha corso, ch’el trova una lama,
blocks.translation: Not far it runs before it finds a plain

blocks.source: ne la qual si distende e la ’mpaluda;
blocks.translation: In which it spreads itself, and makes it marshy,

blocks.source: e suol di state talor essere grama.
blocks.translation: And oft ’tis wont in summer to be sickly.

blocks.source: Quindi passando la vergine cruda
blocks.translation: Passing that way the virgin pitiless

blocks.source: vide terra, nel mezzo del pantano,
blocks.translation: Land in the middle of the fen descried,

blocks.source: sanza coltura e d’abitanti nuda.
blocks.translation: Untilled and naked of inhabitants;

blocks.source: Lì, per fuggire ogne consorzio umano,
blocks.translation: There to escape all human intercourse,

blocks.source: ristette con suoi servi a far sue arti,
blocks.translation: She with her servants stayed, her arts to practise

blocks.source: e visse, e vi lasciò suo corpo vano.
blocks.translation: And lived, and left her empty body there.

blocks.source: Li uomini poi che ’ntorno erano sparti
blocks.translation: The men, thereafter, who were scattered round,

blocks.source: s’accolsero a quel loco, ch’era forte
blocks.translation: Collected in that place, which was made strong

blocks.source: per lo pantan ch’avea da tutte parti.
blocks.translation: By the lagoon it had on every side;

blocks.source: Fer la città sovra quell’ ossa morte;
blocks.translation: They built their city over those dead bones,

blocks.source: e per colei che ’l loco prima elesse,
blocks.translation: And, after her who first the place selected,

blocks.source: Mantüa l’appellar sanz’ altra sorte.
blocks.translation: Mantua named it, without other omen.

blocks.source: Già fuor le genti sue dentro più spesse,
blocks.translation: Its people once within more crowded were,

blocks.source: prima che la mattia da Casalodi
blocks.translation: Ere the stupidity of Casalodi

blocks.source: da Pinamonte inganno ricevesse.
blocks.translation: From Pinamonte had received deceit.

blocks.source: Però t’assenno che, se tu mai odi
blocks.translation: Therefore I caution thee, if e’er thou hearest

blocks.source: originar la mia terra altrimenti,
blocks.translation: Originate my city otherwise,

blocks.source: la verità nulla menzogna frodi».
blocks.translation: No falsehood may the verity defraud.”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, i tuoi ragionamenti
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, thy discourses are

blocks.source: mi son sì certi e prendon sì mia fede,
blocks.translation: To me so certain, and so take my faith,

blocks.source: che li altri mi sarien carboni spenti.
blocks.translation: That unto me the rest would be spent coals.

blocks.source: Ma dimmi, de la gente che procede,
blocks.translation: But tell me of the people who are passing,

blocks.source: se tu ne vedi alcun degno di nota;
blocks.translation: If any one note-worthy thou beholdest,

blocks.source: ché solo a ciò la mia mente rifiede».
blocks.translation: For only unto that my mind reverts.”

blocks.source: Allor mi disse: «Quel che da la gota
blocks.translation: Then said he to me: “He who from the cheek

blocks.source: porge la barba in su le spalle brune,
blocks.translation: Thrusts out his beard upon his swarthy shoulders

blocks.source: fu—quando Grecia fu di maschi vòta,
blocks.translation: Was, at the time when Greece was void of males,

blocks.source: sì ch’a pena rimaser per le cune—
blocks.translation: So that there scarce remained one in the cradle,

blocks.source: augure, e diede ’l punto con Calcanta
blocks.translation: An augur, and with Calchas gave the moment,

blocks.source: in Aulide a tagliar la prima fune.
blocks.translation: In Aulis, when to sever the first cable.

blocks.source: Euripilo ebbe nome, e così ’l canta
blocks.translation: Eurypylus his name was, and so sings

blocks.source: l’alta mia tragedìa in alcun loco:
blocks.translation: My lofty Tragedy in some part or other;

blocks.source: ben lo sai tu che la sai tutta quanta.
blocks.translation: That knowest thou well, who knowest the whole of it.

blocks.source: Quell’ altro che ne’ fianchi è così poco,
blocks.translation: The next, who is so slender in the flanks,

blocks.source: Michele Scotto fu, che veramente
blocks.translation: Was Michael Scott, who of a verity

blocks.source: de le magiche frode seppe ’l gioco.
blocks.translation: Of magical illusions knew the game.

blocks.source: Vedi Guido Bonatti; vedi Asdente,
blocks.translation: Behold Guido Bonatti, behold Asdente,

blocks.source: ch’avere inteso al cuoio e a lo spago
blocks.translation: Who now unto his leather and his thread

blocks.source: ora vorrebbe, ma tardi si pente.
blocks.translation: Would fain have stuck, but he too late repents.

blocks.source: Vedi le triste che lasciaron l’ago,
blocks.translation: Behold the wretched ones, who left the needle,

blocks.source: la spuola e ’l fuso, e fecersi ’ndivine;
blocks.translation: The shuttle and spindle, and made them fortune-tellers;

blocks.source: fecer malie con erbe e con imago.
blocks.translation: They wrought their magic spells with herb and image.

blocks.source: Ma vienne omai, ché già tiene ’l confine
blocks.translation: But come now, for already holds the confines

blocks.source: d’amendue li emisperi e tocca l’onda
blocks.translation: Of both the hemispheres, and under Seville

blocks.source: sotto Sobilia Caino e le spine;
blocks.translation: Touches the ocean-wave, Cain and the thorns,

blocks.source: e già iernotte fu la luna tonda:
blocks.translation: And yesternight the moon was round already;

blocks.source: ben ten de’ ricordar, ché non ti nocque
blocks.translation: Thou shouldst remember well it did not harm thee

blocks.source: alcuna volta per la selva fonda».
blocks.translation: From time to time within the forest deep.”

blocks.source: Sì mi parlava, e andavamo introcque.
blocks.translation: Thus spake he to me, and we walked the while.
